[Upassaya+sutta]  CL=10 Upasaya Sutta:
After the Buddha"s parinibbāna, Venerable Mahākassapa and Venerable Ānanda visited a bhikkhuni monastery. After Venerable Mahākassapa gave a Dhamma talk and departed, the bhikkhuni Thullatissā expressed her disapproval, saying:
'Why does Venerable Mahākassapa think it appropriate to teach Dhamma in the presence of the wise Venerable Ānanda? It"s like a needle-seller trying to sell needles to a needle-maker!'
Due to this incident, Venerable Mahākassapa addressed Venerable Ānanda, declaring his own qualities comparable to the Buddha"s. He then said:
'Whoever thinks they can obscure my six higher knowledges (abhiññā) is like someone thinking they can cover a seven-cubit elephant with a young palm leaf.'
